notes: Eight distinct interaction episodes are visible. The two leaves of each double closet are treated separately because they are independently movable parts. The utensil drawer appears to close near frame 1100 and reopen near frame 1108, so these are retained as two adjacent episodes rather than merged.
scene_description: A user surveys an apartment, then opens and closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a kitchen utensil drawer twice.
